text:
nick: Short follow-up from the postmortem: we still need firm owners + measurable targets for the rollout hardening work (auto-rollback, flag defaults, blast-radius sims).

tara: I can pick up the rollback controller changes. Plan: soft-reroute (80% to stable) within 90s, hard revert within 4m. I'll add a unit test that replays the incident trace. ETA 8 business days.

evan: I'll take flag governance. New policy: any flag that affects routing/model selection must set risk_level and default_state=false unless exception. I'll add a validator to flag-registry and migration steps. ETA 4 days.

ops-bot: Tickets created: <https://tracker/redwood/INF-4010|INF-4010> rollback (tara); <https://tracker/redwood/INF-4011|INF-4011> flag-validator (evan); <https://tracker/redwood/INF-4012|INF-4012> blast-radius harness (sre-maya).

sre-maya: Blast-radius harness plan: small chaos runner that replays a 5-15m spike and verifies rollback success and timings. Will run in staging + canary. ETA 7 days; need one-off creds for canary.

nick: Please add these measurable SLAs to the tickets: detection <= 90s, soft-reroute <= 2m, full revert <= 4m. Also include a short oncall checklist: how to force a soft-reroute, how to pin to last-stable artifact, and which dashboards to check.

tara: Adding a suggested Prom rule to INF-4010: alert: RolloutSafetyTrip expr: increase(errors_total[5m])/increase(requests_total[5m]) > 0.006 for: 2m labels: {severity: "critical"}. We'll wire it into the rollout-operator to mark execution quarantined.

evan: Flag metadata example I'm adding to the registry: flag_name: rerank_beta owners: ["evan"] risk_level: high default_state: false rollout_window: 30m. Validator will block default_state=true for high/critical unless approved_by is set.

sre-maya: I'll attach a sanitized replay of the incident traffic to INF-4012 and include an automated check that verifies the controller's revert path.

nick: Weekly quick check-in Friday 09:15 for 15m. Owners, please add ETAs in tickets by EOD tomorrow and ping me if infra access blocks testing. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
